title: The ten-count rule omits AC15's explicit requirement that a pull request with no recorded external review is n
text: The ten-count rule omits AC15's explicit requirement that a pull request with no recorded external review is never adjudicated. As written, a head containing only Ronda findings can satisfy the listed terminal outcomes and count vacuously. Require same-head external-review evidence before a cohort head can be terminal/count, and cover this rule in the evidence-record test.
